name: CHROMOTHERAPY
text:
So you want to buy a replacement part or a chromotherapy upgrade for your infrared sauna?

Chromotherapy is a treatment aimed at improving health through the use of colours. It is also referred to as sound therapy.

There is plenty of science suggesting that we’re programmed to respond to certain colours positively and chromotherapy makes use of this knowledge through technical means.

We’re able to provide chromotherapy solutions to your sauna, whether an upgrade or a replacement part.

Please use the contact form to tell us if you have a problem or select from a choice of chromotherapy items to add to your sauna experience.

We’re looking forward to making your infrared sauna experience more enjoyable.
text_short: Chromotherapy, also known as Color Therapy, is an ancient healing technique, which involves applying different colors to the human body. It helps to restore the energy balance on emotional and physical levels while increasing the electromagnetic field of the body (Aura). Chromotherapy has been used universally in Ayurveda and traditional Chinese medicine for hundreds of years.
